issue.title: [IPinIP decap] Test to verify DSCP pipe mode

failure.body:
**Description**

Require test to verify DSCP pipe mode for Broadcom platforms (202012 version and above). With the [PR ](https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/pull/7234) to change dscp mode from pipe to uniform, need a test enhancement to cover pipe mode.

This enhancement can be done over the current [test_decap.py](https://github.com/Azure/sonic-mgmt/blob/master/tests/decap/test_decap.py#L109) script. resolution.title: made test_decap to check both DSCP/TTL modes for SONiC 202012 and later
resolution.description:
### Description of PR

Summary: made test_decap to check both DSCP/TTL modes for SONiC 202012 and later
Fix https://github.com/Azure/sonic-mgmt/issues/3355

- uniform mode for ttl and dscp became available for IPinIP tunnel configuration starting from 202012 so made the test to run with ttl/dscp uniform mode for OS ver 202012 and later.

### Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Testbed and Framework(new/improvement)
- [x] Test case(new/improvement)

### Back port request
- [ ] 201911

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?
Adapt the test to covered feature improvements
#### How did you do it?
Parametrized the test to run with uniform ttl/dscp mode if supported for a given OS ver
#### How did you verify/test it?
py.test --inventory=../ansible/lab,../ansible/veos --testbed_file=../ansible/testbed.csv --module-path=../ansible/library -v -rA --topology=any decap/test_decap.py
